Standard: For current handling capability and voltage drop, air vehicle wire sizes, including new and impacted existing wiring, are IAW SAE AS50881, Current Carrying Capacity paragraphs and Voltage Drop paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) A wiring design documentation (e.g., schematics, drawings, and models) review verifies wiring sizes are identified. Analysis.
  (1) A wiring analysis verifies sizing of electrical conductors and selection of insulation types are IAW SAE AS50881, Current Carrying Capacity paragraphs and Voltage Drop paragraph.
